title: fix(rest)!: the approvals request list refuses a status value no approval request can have
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgMwxPY5sbyTBJiFwuYyp3nB)_

domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZMkHvuDeVYgTD73qF

Fixes #29880

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — an unknown `status` value (and an empty `status=` or empty comma entry) answered 200 and now answers 400 naming the allowed values; the widening half: a comma list of declared statuses now filters on all of them, where it matched no row
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：审批收件箱列表接口 `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests` 现在会核对 `status` 的取值，必须是审批请求真实存在的状态（pending、approved、rejected、recalled、returned、cancelled）。
- 为什么改：以前把状态拼错（如 `Pending`、`waiting`）会得到「没有待审」的空列表，对接的机器人或提醒脚本会静默跳过本该提醒的审批；现在答 400，并列出允许的值。
- 顺带修好：SDK 按数组查多个状态时发的是逗号列表（`pending,returned`），以前被当成一个值，永远查不到；现在按多个状态一起查。
- 风险：这是 BREAKING（收紧）。发错状态值或发空 `status=` 的脚本会开始收到 400；控制台和 SDK 只发合法值，不受影响。回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts` 里的 `readApprovalStatusFilter` 和列表路由调用它的那几行。
- 需要你做的：合同评审通过后，落地前需要你点头（BREAKING）。

## What changes

- **The list route reads `?status=` against the declared value set.** `readApprovalStatusFilter` (module-private, `approvals-routes.ts`) splits the value on commas, trims each entry, and requires each to be one of `APPROVAL_STATUSES` (`@objectstack/spec/contracts`), spelt exactly. Otherwise the route answers `400` with the nested `{ error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message } }` body the name gate (#7527) and the arity gate (#6877) on the same handler answer; the message names each bad value once and lists every allowed value, and the service is not asked.
- **Where the allowed set comes from.** `sys_approval_request.status`'s select options are built from `APPROVAL_STATUSES` (`sys-approval-request.object.ts`, #3786), so the route reads the object's own declaration at its source rather than keeping a second list, and needs no metadata read per inbox poll.
- **Order of the gates.** Name, then arity, then value: a request that commits several errors still gets the more fundamental answer first.
- **One status** reaches the service as the string it always did. **Several** reach it as the `ApprovalStatus[]` that `IApprovalService.listRequests` already accepts (pushed down as `$in`), deduplicated; `countRequests` gets the same filter, so `total` matches.
- **Empty is refused.** `?status=` and an empty entry (`?status=pending,`) name no status. Today `?status=` answers every status (the service treats `''` as no filter), so reading it as absent would widen silently; it is part of the narrowing.

## Why

Card measured at `589049b0`, re-measured at `c5800818` before any edit (HTTP layer, the route's own handler with a recording service):

| request | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `?status=pending` | 200, service got `"pending"` | unchanged |
| `?status=bogus` / `?status=Pending` | 200 `{"data":[]}`, service got the string as is | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, service not called |
| `?status=pending,returned` | 200 `{"data":[]}`, service got `"pending,returned"` | 200, service got `["pending","returned"]` |
| `?status=pending&status=returned` | 400 (arity gate) | unchanged |

The comma row matters because `@objectstack/client`'s `approvals.listRequests({ status: [...] })` joins an array with commas. Validating the whole string would have turned that SDK call from a silent empty list into a 400; splitting makes it work. The seat agreed to this reading before the gates ran.

## Tests

- **New `rest-server-approvals-status-value.test.ts`** (16 cases, the #7527 harness: a real `RestServer`, the registered handler, a recording approvals service).
  - Refusals assert status 400, nested `error.code`, the located message (each bad value, every allowed value) and that neither `listRequests` nor `countRequests` ran: `bogus`, `Pending`, a comma list with one bad entry (named once), `''`, `pending,`, a nested query object; and that the name and arity gates still answer first.
  - Preservation asserts the argument the service received: each of the six declared statuses as a string, a known status with no rows still `200 {"data":[]}`, a comma list as an array, trimming and dedupe, no `status` leaves the filter unset, and a paged comma-list request counts `total` on the same array.
- **Updated** `rest-server-approvals-unknown-filter.test.ts`: the "every name in the closed set is accepted" case sent `'1'` to every name; it now sends `status=pending`, since `'1'` is not a status.

## Verification

All at head `976da77f` (`origin/main` merged once, before the gates).

- **Ablation.** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `const statusRead = readApprovalStatusFilter(q.status);` with a pass-through (`{ status: q.status }`), blob `a9c203f5` → `6b2eac2a`, then ran the new file: 8 failed / 8 passed. The 8 failures are every refusal case plus the three comma-list preservation cases; the 8 that pass are the single-status and name/arity preservation cases, which must hold either way. Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Suites.** `@objectstack/rest` vitest: 392 files, 7,639 passed, 352 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest run typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- **Lint.** `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 58 commands; all 58 exit 0 after a full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'`. `--ran` reconciles 58 derived, 58 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Acceptance notes

- No `ui/**` change is needed: the console's inbox sends only `pending` and its status picker offers `pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, `recalled`, `returned`; the bell feed sends `pending`.
- Possible follow-up for the seat: the status picker in `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` has no `cancelled` entry although the route and the object both have it (ui lane, not touched here).
